name: Kaminokuni (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kaminokuni town emblem in red: a disc bearing the characters 上ノ国 in white.
history: Municipal flag of Kaminokuni, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1927.

features.role: Kaminokuni town emblem — a disc bearing the characters 上ノ国 in white
